SOCIAL MEDIA
PERPETUAL ADORATION

We have a hearing loop
An assistive listening system known as an induction loop or a hearing loop has been installed in the church. The system allows parishioners with hearing loss to hear services easily and clearly with the use of their own hearing aid, implant or a receiver. For more information - see the ushers at Mass.
